task_text: 核查以下声明，搜索外部证据。依据实际证据回答，说明结论范围与不确定性：TRUMP said If he was a great president (barack Obama), how come he left me 138 judges to appoint when everybody said that’s the single most important thing a president of the United States has to do?（声明日期：2019-08-15）
task_text_en: Fact-check the following claim by searching for external evidence. Answer based on the evidence actually obtained, and state the scope of the conclusion and its uncertainties: TRUMP said If he was a great president (barack Obama), how come he left me 138 judges to appoint when everybody said that’s the single most important thing a president of the United States has to do? (claim date: 2019-08-15)
